name: The Joker
fact: The Joker was the villian in Batman's very first issue (without the title of 'detective comics,') and was initially supposed to be killed off, but was saved by editorial intervention. This decision would allow him to become Batman's archenemy, and becoming the majority favourite among fans. In his earlier appearances he was merely a comical prankster, then once the 'comic code authority' lifted some of it's rules, he became more of an evil character.

name: Bane
fact: Bane proved to be one of Batman's most physical threats when he broke his back in the comic book 'Knightfall,' causing Batman to rise back up both mentally and physically. Bane is also one of the most intelligent villian's in the rogues gallery.

name: Ra's Al Ghul
fact: Ra's Al Ghul has been alive for hundreds of years due to bathing in the Lazareth Pit, giving him the supernatural ability to stay young. He is the leader of the League of Assasins and is the father of Talia Al Ghul, the mother of Batman's son, Damien Wayne.

name: Mr. Freeze
fact: Mr. Freeze, also known as Victor Fries, originally had the name Mr. Zero when he was created. He was a scientist who studied cryonics. His wife Nora had an incurable disease, and with his knowledge on cryonics, he found a way to freeze his wife while still being alive, so he can do the necessary research to save her.

name: The Penquin
fact: The Penquin, also known as Oswald Copplepot, was ranked #51 in IGN's list of 'Top 100 Comic Book Villians.' The Penquin is Gotham City's most feared and powerful underground crime-boss. With his influence in the city, his iconic purple umbrella, which are also weapons, and his exploding wind-up penquins, he's a great threat to batman, that outmatches brute strength.

name: The Riddler
fact: The Riddler, also known as Edward Nygma, or Edward Nashton, has one of the most brilliant minds. He knew he was smarter than anyone in any room he was in, and his ego grew to the point of obession. The obession of needing to be the smartest person was nothing compared to when Batman solved his deadly game of riddles, forever seeing Batman as his true rival.

name: The Scarecrow
fact: The Scarecrow, Also known as Jonathan Crane, was a scientist who studied the psychology of fear and the effects of the mind. Crane developed a hallucinogen that made those who were exposed to it, see their worst fears, and in the worst cases, either drive them insane, or die of a heart attack. Batman has been the only one to successfully overcome Scarecrows drug and stop his mission to cause fear around the city.

name: Harley Quinn
first-appearance: Batman: The Animated series, Episode 22 ('Joker's Favor')
fact: Harley Quinn was not created for a comic book, unlike most other characters on this list, instead she was an original character for Batman's telivision show in the 90's. Harleen Quinzel was a therapist, working in the mental institute 'Arkham Asylum.' One of her infamous patients was The Joker. Quinzel was facinated by him from the start, and grew an attachment to him. She became obessed with The Joker and helped break him out of Arkham Asylum. She changed her name to 'Harley Quinn' and became his right-hand woman.

name: Killer Croc
fact: Killer Croc, Also known as Waylon Jones, was a former sideshow wrestler. He had a rare genetic condition that gave him reptillian features and superhuman strength. This condition drove him mad and he turned to a life of crime. As he became older, he grew stronger and his appearance became more reptillian, fully committing himself to be the monster everyone sees.

name: Man-Bat
fact: Man-Bat is a mutation, accidently created by the human inside. Dr. Robert Kirkland Langstrom was a zoologist who experimented with bat DNA. He wanted to give the human race the ability of acute sonar sense just like a bat. When he experimented on himself, He mutated into a giant bat, and lost control of himself in the creature. Man-Bat would terrorize the city, even killing his own wife in the chaos.

name: Two-Face
fact: Two-Face, also known as Harvey dent, was a district attorney for Gotham City. He was loved by the citizens of the city and had the name 'The white knight,' since he was seen the savior of Gotham, finally taking down the criminal underworld and making the city great again. Unfortunately, when a hitman scarred half of his face with acid, he developed a multiple personality disorder from the trauma. Now he sees justice taken by chance, fliiping a coin to decide the fate of his and others lives, even if it means death.

name: Poison Ivy
fact: Poison Ivy, also known as Pamela Lillian Isley, had a PhD in botany, the study of plants. She created experimented with a mix of chemicas from plants that once she injected herself with them, she could control plants at will, and even speak with them. From then on, she became a voice for nature, and saw humans as a threat. Poison Ivy attempts to protect nature at all cost, even if it means all civilization must perish.

name: Catwoman
fact: Catwoman, Also known as Selena Kyle, was a master thief who could slip in and out of high security buildings to retrieve cash and jewels. Selena grew up homeless, without parents. she learned to fend for herself and did'nt care about breaking the law. Catwoman and Batman, who were each  other's enemies, would eventually grow into a flirtatious, yet complicated relationship. Catwoman would even help Batman with certain missions and be apart of the 'Bat-Family.'

name: Clayface
fact: Clayface, also known as basil Karlo, was a film actor. When he hears they are filming a remake of a movie he starred in, he becomes desperate to stay relevant as an actor, and he gets into contact with daggett industries. They developed a serum that gives anyone the ability to control facial muscles at will, giving Basil the ability to 'out-act' any other actor. But when he gets into contact with the serum, he skin becomes clay-like. He can form his body into any shape, even impersonate other people. But his insanity couldn't take the process and turned to a life of crime.

name: Firefly
fact: Firefly, also known as Garfield Lynns, was a pyromaniac with an obsessive compulsion to start fires and commit arson. He would cause terror around the city. Eventually, he gt caught in his own fire, and suffered third-degree burns all over his body. Lynns would survive, but this would not stop his crimes, instead would fuel his hatred and insanity. He would build a suit that woud allow him to fly and commit more direct crimes.
